subject: Distributor portal billing waterfall — Order Form & MSA clarifications
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@clouddistrib.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudDistrib Legal <legal@clouddistrib.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum — billing waterfall questions

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our finance and legal teams reviewed the marketplace addendum and raised a couple of items we need clarified before we can sign the Order Form:

1) Billing waterfall: our standard requires the reseller (CloudDistrib) to collect customer payments and remit net proceeds to Redwood within 30 days. Your addendum currently references a pass-through fee collection by Redwood for marketplace usage. Can you confirm who will invoice end customers and which entity is responsible for remitting marketplace fees to Redwood?

2) Tax & invoicing: we need Redwood to be able to accept reseller-issued invoices (self-billing) for the usage fees, or alternatively indicate if Redwood requires direct billing.

3) MSA alignment: there are a few cross-references where your MSA lists liability caps for hosted services but the addendum tries to move liability back to the reseller for partner-conducted onboarding. Legal flagged this as inconsistent. I attached our redlines to the partner addendum for reference.

Can we get Redwood's redline back by Wednesday (28th)? If it's easier, happy to set a 30-minute call with legal and finance.

Attachments: CloudDistrib_Addendum_Redlines.docx (redline), Marketplace_OrderForm_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Partnerships
CloudDistrib Solutions
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@clouddistrib.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, CloudDistrib Legal <legal@clouddistrib.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — billing waterfall questions

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the redlines.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood prefers to remain the billed entity for hosted usage to preserve unit metering accuracy and direct SLA accountability, but we're willing to support a reseller pass-through model with two conditions: (1) explicit orderform language that the reseller will remit net proceeds within 30 days, and (2) a limited indemnity carve-out for billing errors and tax reclaim.
- We can accept reseller self-billing invoices in jurisdictions where your tax team requires it; we'll need a short annex in the Order Form specifying invoicing format and tax responsibilities.
- On the MSA cap inconsistencies: we'll propose language that preserves Redwood's hosted-service cap while clarifying that partner-led professional services (onboarding/custom integration) fall under the reseller's liability. That keeps both sides' protections intact.

I'm attaching our redline to the addendum (Redwood_Response_Redline.docx) and a short draft clause for the billing waterfall. Can you confirm if CloudDistrib needs Redwood to sign the Order Form as the invoiced party, or if you will handle customer invoicing and send us monthly remits?

If useful, let's do a 30-minute triage with your legal + finance tomorrow 11:00am PT. I can loop Karthik (commercial lead) and Lauren (contracts ops).

Attachments: Redwood_Response_Redline.docx

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Marketplace addendum — billing waterfall questions

Karthik / Lauren — forwarding CloudDistrib's redlines and my reply. Key asks from them: confirm invoicing model, allow reseller self-billing, and align MSA caps for partner services.

Proposal for deal stance:
- Offer two supported billing flows in the Order Form: (A) Redwood invoices end customers (preferred for now), or (B) CloudDistrib invoices customers and remits to Redwood monthly (30-day net). For B, require a short billing annex, payment reconciliation window, and a capped liability for tax/billing discrepancies (e.g., limited to fees incorrectly remitted in the prior 3 months).
- Accept reseller self-billing with standard VAT/withholding confirmations and a KYC invoicing contact.
- Update MSA language to exclude partner-provided professional services from Redwood's hosted-service liability cap; Draft clause attached here (see Redwood_Response_Redline.docx).

Next steps: 1) If you agree with the two-flow approach, I'll present it to CloudDistrib tomorrow in the triage call. 2) If legal needs a tighter cap or escrow language, we should surface that now.

Also noting the procurement team may request a one-time onboarding credit; if procurement pushes, would prefer to handle as a commercial concession rather than adjust MSA terms.

LMK quickly — I'll schedule the call if I don't hear objections by 4pm PT.

Sean
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@clouddistrib.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudDistrib Legal <legal@clouddistrib.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — billing waterfall questions

Thanks Sean — that approach is workable. Our preference is flow B (CloudDistrib invoices, Redwood receives monthly remits) given reseller-led billing across our marketplace. We reviewed your proposed carve-outs and the redline looks reasonable pending two small edits:

1) Limit the reconciliation lookback to 60 days (CloudDistrib finance prefers 60 vs. your suggested 90).
2) Add a short sentence confirming Redwood will accept reseller-formatted self-billing invoices where permitted; where not available we'll default to Redwood invoices.

We're good to proceed if Redwood accepts those two edits. I'll have legal prepare a final redline and send for e-signature once we have your confirmation. Can we close this and route to DocuSign today?

Attachments: CloudDistrib_Final_Redline.docx

Best,
Maya
Head of Partnerships
CloudDistrib Solutions
